        -- 统计角色使用

        if characterLo then
            -- 已配置角色只获得明确填写的起始工具；空字符串代表完全空手
            local starterTool = characterLo.starterTool
            if type(starterTool) == "string" and starterTool ~= "" then
                local startToolIds = starterTool:split(",")
                for _,toolId in ipairs(startToolIds) do
                    local itemId = tonumber(toolId)
                    if not itemId then continue end

                    local tool = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(itemId)
                    if tool then
                        ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,tool)
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            -- 未选择职业时装备默认起始工具
            local bag = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(101)
            local axe = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(104)
            ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,bag)
            ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,axe)
        end
    end

    -- 初始化永久性加成
    for key,num in pairs(playerVo.permanentUpgrades) do
        local puId = tonumber(key)
        local puLo:PermanentUpgradeSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(PermanentUpgradeSetting,puId)
        if not puLo then continue end

        if puLo.processor == CommonEnum.PermanentUpgradesType.BagSize then
            local upSize = tonumber(puLo.param)
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.BagSizeBonus,string.format("永久加成.%d",puLo.id),upSize)

            if characterLo and characterLo.disablePermanentStartItems then continue end
            if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) then continue end -- 如果是重连，跳过

            local itemId = tonumber(puLo.param)
            local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(itemId)
            local resItem = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(itemId)
            if resItemLo.IsTool then
                ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,resItem)
            end
        elseif puLo.processor == CommonEnum.PermanentUpgradesType.Revive then
            if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) then continue end -- 如果是重连，跳过

            v_ReviveTimes.Value += tonumber(puLo.param)
        end
    end

    -- 初始化角色技能天赋

        end

            end
        end
    end

    task.wait(1)
    local character = player.Character
    if not playerGameData.alive then

        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
    end

    -- 携带道具

                local num = DataHelper:GetItem(player,itemId)

            end

            local pack:Model = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("其他"):WaitForChild("携带道具"):Clone()
            pack:PivotTo(cframe + cframe.LookVector * 5)
            pack.Parent = workspace
            ValueHelper:SetValue(pack,"ownedUserId",player.UserId)
        end

        -- for i,itemId in ipairs(carryResItems) do
        --     local itemLo:ItemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(ItemSetting,itemId)

v_isDaytime.Changed:Connect(function(value)
    if v_isDaytime.Value then
        -- 白天
        if v_day.Value > 2 then
            if v_day.Value > 7 then
                -- 随机小鹿红眼状态
                GameHelper:RandomDeerState()
            else
                -- n天之前，小鹿不会饥饿
                GameHelper.deerState = GameEnum.DeerState.Nromal
            end
        end

        -- 移除夜晚怪物
        local nightEnemys = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.NightEnemy)
        for _,enemy:Model in ipairs(nightEnemys) do
            enemy:Destroy()
        end

        -- 小鹿离开
        GameHelper:DeerStunned()
        task.wait(2)
        GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
        if GameHelper.deerState == GameEnum.DeerState.Hungry then
            UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireAllClients("🩸The monster is very hungry tonight.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Morning)
        end
    else
        if v_isFullMoon.Value then
            -- 满月,小鹿不会出现
        else
            -- 小鹿出现判定
            if v_day.Value == 1 then
                print("第一晚小鹿偷看营火")
                GameHelper:DeerTryAppear(GameEnum.DeerState.Peep)
            elseif v_day.Value >= 3 then
                local heat = GameHelper:GetCampfireHeat()
                if heat > 0 and GameHelper:IsCanAttackCampfire() then
                    GameHelper:DeerTryAppear(GameEnum.DeerState.Peep)
                    print("小鹿观战营地突袭")
                end

                local cd = 10
                while not v_isDaytime.Value do
                    if GameHelper:DeerIsFree() then
                        -- print("小鹿出现检测倒计时",cd)
                        if cd <= 0 then
                            cd = 10
                            GameHelper:DeerTryAppear(GameHelper.deerState)
                        end
                    else
                        cd = 10
                    end
                    local dt = task.wait()
                    cd -= dt
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

GameHelper.OpenTreasureC2S.OnServerInvoke = function(player,part:Instance)
    if player.Character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) then return end
    local treasure:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(part,GameEnum.Tag.Treasure)
    if not treasure then return end

    local enabled = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(treasure,TreasureValue.enable)
    if not enabled then return end

    local userId = player.UserId
    if not _treasureMark[userId] then _treasureMark[userId] = {} end

    local openedTreasures = _treasureMark[userId]
    for i = #openedTreasures,1,-1 do
        local openedTreasure = openedTreasures[i]
        if not openedTreasure or not openedTreasure:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            table.remove(openedTreasures,i)
        end
    end

    if table.find(openedTreasures,treasure) then
        warn("OpenTreasureC2S: Player has already opened this treasure.")
        return
    end

    local ItemPoint:Attachment = treasure:FindFirstChild("ItemPoint",true)
    if not ItemPoint then
        warn("OpenTreasureC2S: Treasure does not have ItemPoint attachment.")
        return
    end

    -- 记录这个宝箱已打开
    table.insert(openedTreasures,treasure)

    -- 创建道具
    local randomId = treasure:GetAttribute("RandomId")
    if randomId <= 6 and math.random(1,100) == 1 then
        -- 奖励1个钻石给他吧
        ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(9,ItemPoint.WorldCFrame.Position,player)
    else
        -- 正常随机奖励
        local items = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(randomId,ItemPoint.WorldCFrame.Position,player)
        for _,gun:Tool in ipairs(items) do
            if gun:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) then
                GameHelper:CreateBulletFromGun(gun)
            end
        end
    end

    if randomId == 7 then
        -- 如果是恶魔宝箱，转化成6级宝箱
        treasure:SetAttribute("RandomId",6)
    end

    GameHelper.onOpenTreasure:Fire(player,treasure)
    return true
end

GameHelper.RescuePlayerC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(playerWhoTriggered:Player,targetPlayer:Player)
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(playerWhoTriggered) then return end

    if playerWhoTriggered:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.FreeRescue) then
        playerWhoTriggered:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.FreeRescue)
        -- 如果有免费营救能力，走免费营救专属的复活流程
        local character = playerWhoTriggered.Character
        local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid.Health > 1 then
            -- 扣50%血量，最低保留1点血量
            local costHealth = humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.5
            if costHealth > humanoid.Health then
                costHealth = humanoid.Health - 1
            end

            -- 扣血
            GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(playerWhoTriggered,costHealth,nil,true)

            -- 复活玩家
            GameHelper:PlayerRevive(targetPlayer)
            DataHelper:AddStats(playerWhoTriggered,CommonEnum.Stats.Save,1)

            -- 触发事件
            GameHelper.onReviveTeammate:Fire(playerWhoTriggered,targetPlayer)
        end
    else
        -- 普通复活流程

        -- 获得身上的绷带/医疗包
        local healTool = ToolHelper:GetToolByType(playerWhoTriggered,GameEnum.Tag.Heal)

        if healTool then
            ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(healTool)
            GameHelper:PlayerRevive(targetPlayer)
            DataHelper:AddStats(playerWhoTriggered,CommonEnum.Stats.Save,1)
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("使用绷带",playerWhoTriggered.Character)
            -- 使用道具
            ToolHelper.onUseTool:Fire(playerWhoTriggered,GameEnum.Tag.Heal)
            
            -- 触发事件
            GameHelper.onReviveTeammate:Fire(playerWhoTriggered,targetPlayer)
        else
            playerWhoTriggered:SetAttribute("ReviveFriendId",targetPlayer.UserId)
            MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(playerWhoTriggered,GameEnum.ProductID.ReviveFriend)
            -- UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(playerWhoTriggered,"You need healing items.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
        end
    end

end)

CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.NPCPoisoned):Connect(function(npc:Model)
    while true do
        task.wait(1)
        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) and not npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCPoisoned) then break end
        local endTime = GameHelper:GetNPCPoisonedStartTime(npc) + 10.5
        if workspace.DistributedGameTime > endTime then
            npc:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCPoisoned)
            break
        else
            local player = game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(GameHelper:GetNPCPoisonedByPlayerUserId(npc))
            -- 中毒伤害加成
            local bonus = 0
            if player and  player.Character then
                bonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player.Character,CharacterValue.poisonDamageBonus)
            end
            -- 计算伤害
            local damage = 6
            damage += damage * bonus
            GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage,GameEnum.DamageSource.Poisoned)
        end
    end
end)

local function setTag(instance, tag, enabled)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then
		return
	end
	local hasTag = CollectionService:HasTag(instance, tag)
	if enabled and not hasTag then
		CollectionService:AddTag(instance, tag)
	elseif not enabled and hasTag then
		CollectionService:RemoveTag(instance, tag)
	end
end

local function findPrompt(npc)
	if not npc then
		return nil
	end
	return npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
end

local function setPromptAvailable(npc, available)
	local prompt = findPrompt(npc)
	if not prompt then
		return nil
	end
	prompt:SetAttribute(DIALOG_PROMPT_LOCK_ATTRIBUTE, not available)
	prompt.Enabled = available
	return prompt
end

local function setDialogGuiEnabled(npc, enabled)
	local head = npc and npc:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local dialogGui = head and head:FindFirstChild("gui")
	if dialogGui and dialogGui:IsA("BillboardGui") then
		dialogGui.Enabled = enabled
	end
end

local function setTalkBubble(npc, text, enabled)
	if not npc then
		return
	end
	local head = npc:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local bubble = head and head:FindFirstChild("talkBubble")
	if not bubble then
		return
	end
	if bubble:IsA("BillboardGui") then
		bubble.Enabled = enabled
	end
	local label = bubble:FindFirstChild("t_help", true)
	if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") then
		label.Text = text
	end
end

local function getRoot(model)
	return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function getHumanoid(model)
	return model and model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
end

local function cloneRelative(sourceInstance, sourceRoot, targetRoot, cloneSource)
	if not sourceInstance or not sourceRoot or not targetRoot then
		return nil
	end
	local template = cloneSource or sourceInstance
	local clone = template:Clone()
	local relative = sourceRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(sourceInstance:GetPivot())
	clone:PivotTo(targetRoot.CFrame * relative)
	return clone
end

	self.state = newState
	if self.stage1Building and self.stage1Building.Parent then
		self.stage1Building:SetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestState", newState)
	end
	if self.stage2Building and self.stage2Building.Parent then
		self.stage2Building:SetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestState", newState)
	end
	if self.npc and self.npc.Parent then
		self.npc:SetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestState", newState)
	end

	local dialogAvailable = newState == self.State.RESCUED or newState == self.State.CEMETERY_DIALOG
	setPromptAvailable(self.npc, dialogAvailable)
	setDialogGuiEnabled(self.npc, newState == self.State.RESCUE or dialogAvailable)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_setOwner(player)
	self.owner = player
	local userId = player and player.UserId or 0
	if self.npc and self.npc.Parent then
		self.npc:SetAttribute("OldCowboyEscortOwnerUserId", userId)
	end
	if self.stage1Building and self.stage1Building.Parent then
		self.stage1Building:SetAttribute("OldCowboyEscortOwnerUserId", userId)
	end
	if self.stage2Building and self.stage2Building.Parent then
		self.stage2Building:SetAttribute("OldCowboyEscortOwnerUserId", userId)
	end
	if self.npc and self.npc.Parent then
		local ownerValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(self.npc, AnimalBuddyValue.ownerPlayer)
		if ownerValue then
			ownerValue.Value = player
		end
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_isPlayerNearNpc(player, maxDistance)
	if not player or not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then
		return false
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local npcRoot = getRoot(self.npc)
	if not playerRoot or not npcRoot then
		return false
	end
	return (playerRoot.Position - npcRoot.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_findNearestAlivePlayer(excludedPlayer)
	local npcRoot = getRoot(self.npc)
	if not npcRoot then
		return nil
	end
	local nearest = nil
	local nearestDistance = math.huge
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= excludedPlayer and GameHelper:isAlive(player) then
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local distance = (root.Position - npcRoot.Position).Magnitude
				if distance < nearestDistance then
					nearest = player
					nearestDistance = distance
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_assignReplacementOwner(excludedPlayer)
	if self.owner then
		return self.owner
	end
	local replacement = self:_findNearestAlivePlayer(excludedPlayer)
	if replacement then
		self:_setOwner(replacement)
		if self.state == self.State.CEMETERY_FILM then
			self:_finishCemeteryFilm()
		end
	end
	return replacement
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_ensureForceField()
	if not self.npc or not self.npc.Parent then
		return
	end
	local forceField = self.npc:FindFirstChild("OldCowboyQuestForceField")
	if not forceField then
		forceField = Instance.new("ForceField")
		forceField.Name = "OldCowboyQuestForceField"
		forceField.Visible = false
		forceField.Parent = self.npc
	end
	return forceField
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_removeForceField()
	if not self.npc then
		return
	end
	local forceField = self.npc:FindFirstChild("OldCowboyQuestForceField")
	if forceField then
		forceField:Destroy()
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_allStage1SlotsDefeated()
	for _, point in ipairs(self.stage1Points) do
		if not point:GetAttribute("Defeated") then
			return false
		end
	end
	return #self.stage1Points > 0
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_completeRescue()
	if self.state ~= self.State.RESCUE then
		return
	end
	if not self:_allStage1SlotsDefeated() then
		return
	end
	self:_setState(self.State.RESCUED)
	local completed = self.stage1Building:FindFirstChild("已完成")
	if completed and completed:IsA("BoolValue") then
		completed.Value = true
	end
	setTalkBubble(self.npc, "Thank you... There's something I need to ask you.", true)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_spawnEnemyAtPoint(point, folder)
	if self.state ~= self.State.RESCUE or point:GetAttribute("Defeated") then
		return
	end
	local existing = self.slotEnemies[point]
	if existing and existing.Parent and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(existing) then
		return
	end
	local enemyId = tonumber(point.Name)
	if not enemyId then
		return
	end
	local enemyLo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(enemyId)
	if not enemyLo then
		warn("OldCowboyQuest: missing enemy config", enemyId)
		return
	end
	local enemy
	enemy = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,folder)
	if not enemy then
		return
	end
	enemy:SetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestEnemy", true)
	enemy:PivotTo(point.WorldCFrame)
	self.slotEnemies[point] = enemy
	local humanoid = getHumanoid(enemy)
	if not humanoid then
		self.slotEnemies[point] = nil
		enemy:Destroy()
		return
	end
	humanoid.Died:Once(function()
		if self.retiringEnemies[enemy] then
			return
		end
		if self.slotEnemies[point] == enemy then
			self.slotEnemies[point] = nil
		end
		point:SetAttribute("Defeated", true)
		if enemy.Parent == folder then
			enemy.Parent = Workspace
		end
		self:_completeRescue()
	end)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_spawnStage1Enemies()
	if self.state ~= self.State.RESCUE then
		return
	end
	local triggered = self.stage1Building:FindFirstChild("已触发对话")
	if triggered and triggered:IsA("BoolValue") then
		triggered.Value = true
	end
	setTalkBubble(self.npc, "Help me!😭", true)
	for _, point in ipairs(self.stage1Points) do
		self:_spawnEnemyAtPoint(point, self.stage1EnemyFolder)
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_retireStage1Enemies()
	if self.state ~= self.State.RESCUE then
		return
	end
	for point, enemy in pairs(self.slotEnemies) do
		if enemy and enemy.Parent and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(enemy) then
			self.retiringEnemies[enemy] = true
			enemy:Destroy()
			self.retiringEnemies[enemy] = nil
		end
		self.slotEnemies[point] = nil
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_prepareStage2()
	local ok, result = pcall(self.spawnBuilding, stage2Prefab, {4, 5}, true)
	if not ok then
		warn("OldCowboyQuest: stage 2 spawn failed", result)
		return nil
	end
	if not result then
		return nil
	end

	self.stage2Building = result
	self.stage2Building:SetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestStage", 2)
	self.stage2Root = self.stage2Building:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
	self.cemeteryTrigger = self.stage2Building:FindFirstChild("触发剧情")
	local npcPositionMarker = self.stage2Building:FindFirstChild("Old Cowboy")
	if npcPositionMarker and npcPositionMarker:IsA("Model") then
		self.cemeteryNpcCFrame = npcPositionMarker:GetPivot()
	elseif self.stage2Root then
		warn("OldCowboyQuest: stage 2 is missing the Old Cowboy position marker")
		self.cemeteryNpcCFrame = self.stage2Root.CFrame
	else
		warn("OldCowboyQuest: stage 2 is missing the Old Cowboy position marker and RootPart")
		self.cemeteryNpcCFrame = self.stage2Building:GetPivot()
	end
	if npcPositionMarker then
		npcPositionMarker:Destroy()
	end

	local legacy = self.stage2Building:FindFirstChild("牛仔呼救阶段3据点_server")
	if legacy then
		legacy:Destroy()
	end

	if self.cemeteryTrigger and self.cemeteryTrigger:IsA("BasePart") then
		local triggerSize = self.cemeteryTrigger.Size
		self.cemeteryTrigger.Size = Vector3.new(
			math.max(triggerSize.X, CEMETERY_TRIGGER_MIN_SIZE.X),
			math.max(triggerSize.Y, CEMETERY_TRIGGER_MIN_SIZE.Y),
			math.max(triggerSize.Z, CEMETERY_TRIGGER_MIN_SIZE.Z)
		)
		self.cemeteryTrigger.CanCollide = false
		self.cemeteryTrigger.CanTouch = true
		self.cemeteryTrigger.CanQuery = false
		self.cemeteryTrigger.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			if self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT or not self.owner then
				return
			end
			local character = hit and hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local player = character and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
			if player ~= self.owner then
				return
			end
			self:_beginCemeteryFilm()
		end)
	end
	return result
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_equipEscortPistol()
	local oldTool = self.npc:FindFirstChild("614")
	if oldTool then
		oldTool:Destroy()
	end
	local tool = pistolPrefab:Clone()
	tool.Name = "614"
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	for _, descendant in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BaseScript") then
			descendant.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	tool:SetAttribute("OldCowboyEscortWeapon", true)
	tool.Parent = self.npc
	self.escortPistol = tool
	local humanoid = getHumanoid(self.npc)
	if humanoid then
		humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_destroyEscortPistol()
	if self.escortPistol and self.escortPistol.Parent then
		self.escortPistol:Destroy()
	end
	self.escortPistol = nil
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_setEscortBubble(text)
	if self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT or not self.npc or not self.npc.Parent then
		return
	end
	if self.escortBubbleText == text and self.escortBubbleEnabled then
		return
	end
	self.escortBubbleText = text
	self.escortBubbleEnabled = true
	setTalkBubble(self.npc, text, true)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_hasLiveEscortTarget()
	local target = self.escortTargetValue and self.escortTargetValue.Value
	return target ~= nil and target.Parent ~= nil and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(target)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_refreshEscortBubble()
	if self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT then
		return
	end
	if self.escortReplyText then
		self:_setEscortBubble(self.escortReplyText)
	elseif self.escortInCombat then
		self:_setEscortBubble(self.escortCombatLine or ESCORT_COMBAT_LINES[1])
	elseif self.escortHumanoid and self.escortHumanoid.Health < self.escortHumanoid.MaxHealth then
		self:_setEscortBubble(ESCORT_HURT_LINE)
	else
		self:_setEscortBubble(ESCORT_TRAVEL_LINE)
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_onEscortTargetChanged()
	self.escortCombatExitGeneration = (self.escortCombatExitGeneration or 0) + 1
	if self:_hasLiveEscortTarget() then
		if not self.escortInCombat then
			self.escortCombatLine = ESCORT_COMBAT_LINES[math.random(1, #ESCORT_COMBAT_LINES)]
		end
		self.escortInCombat = true
		self:_refreshEscortBubble()
		return
	end

	local generation = self.escortCombatExitGeneration
	task.delay(ESCORT_COMBAT_END_GRACE, function()
		if generation ~= self.escortCombatExitGeneration
			or self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT
			or self:_hasLiveEscortTarget() then
			return
		end
		self.escortInCombat = false
		self.escortCombatLine = nil
		self:_refreshEscortBubble()
	end)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_showFedReply()
	if self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT then
		return
	end
	self.escortReplyGeneration = (self.escortReplyGeneration or 0) + 1
	local generation = self.escortReplyGeneration
	self.escortReplyText = ESCORT_FED_LINE
	self:_refreshEscortBubble()
	task.delay(ESCORT_FEED_REPLY_DURATION, function()
		if generation ~= self.escortReplyGeneration or self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT then
			return
		end
		self.escortReplyText = nil
		self:_refreshEscortBubble()
	end)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_stopEscortStatus()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.escortStatusConnections or {}) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self.escortStatusConnections = {}
	self.escortCombatExitGeneration = (self.escortCombatExitGeneration or 0) + 1
	self.escortReplyGeneration = (self.escortReplyGeneration or 0) + 1
	self.escortHumanoid = nil
	self.escortTargetValue = nil
	self.escortInCombat = false
	self.escortCombatLine = nil
	self.escortReplyText = nil
	self.escortBubbleText = nil
	self.escortBubbleEnabled = false
	setTalkBubble(self.npc, "", false)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_startEscortStatus()
	self:_stopEscortStatus()
	if self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = getHumanoid(self.npc)
	local targetValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(self.npc, AnimalBuddyValue.targetEnemy)
	if not humanoid or not targetValue then
		warn("OldCowboyQuest: missing escort status values")
		return
	end

	self.escortHumanoid = humanoid
	self.escortTargetValue = targetValue
	table.insert(self.escortStatusConnections, humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
		self:_refreshEscortBubble()
	end))
	table.insert(self.escortStatusConnections, targetValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		self:_onEscortTargetChanged()
	end))

	if self:_hasLiveEscortTarget() then
		self:_onEscortTargetChanged()
	else
		self:_refreshEscortBubble()
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_stopFeedTouch()
	if self.feedTouchConnection then
		self.feedTouchConnection:Disconnect()
		self.feedTouchConnection = nil
	end
	if self.feedHitbox and self.feedHitbox.Parent then
		self.feedHitbox:Destroy()
	end
	self.feedHitbox = nil
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_tryFeedCookedMeat(hit)
	if self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT or not hit then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = getHumanoid(self.npc)
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Health >= humanoid.MaxHealth then
		return
	end

	local isResource, item = ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(hit)
	if not isResource or not item or item:GetAttribute("OldCowboyFeedConsumed") then
		return
	end
	local itemId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(item, DragItemValue.id)
	if itemId ~= GameEnum.ResItemId.CookedMeat then
		return
	end

	local dragPlayer = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(item, DragItemValue.dragPlayer)
	if not dragPlayer or dragPlayer.Parent ~= Players or not GameHelper:isAlive(dragPlayer) then
		return
	end
	if ValueHelper:FindValueValue(dragPlayer, PlayerValue.dragItem) ~= item then
		return
	end
	local playerRoot = dragPlayer.Character and dragPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local npcRoot = getRoot(self.npc)
	if not playerRoot or not npcRoot or (playerRoot.Position - npcRoot.Position).Magnitude > OLD_COWBOY_FEED_MAX_PLAYER_DISTANCE then
		return
	end

	item:SetAttribute("OldCowboyFeedConsumed", true)
	ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item)
	if self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local healed = GameHelper:CharacterForceHeal(self.npc, OLD_COWBOY_FEED_HEAL)
	if healed <= 0 then
		return
	end
	AudioHelper:PlayEffect("吃东西", npcRoot)
	self:_showFedReply()
	self.npc:SetAttribute("OldCowboyLastFedByUserId", dragPlayer.UserId)
	self.npc:SetAttribute("OldCowboyLastFeedHeal", math.floor(healed + 0.5))
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_startFeedTouch()
	self:_stopFeedTouch()
	local root = getRoot(self.npc)
	if self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end

	local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
	hitbox.Name = "OldCowboyFeedHitbox"
	hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 6, 5)
	hitbox.CFrame = root.CFrame
	hitbox.Transparency = 1
	hitbox.CastShadow = false
	hitbox.Anchored = false
	hitbox.Massless = true
	hitbox.CanCollide = false
	hitbox.CanQuery = false
	hitbox.CanTouch = true
	hitbox.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Default
	hitbox:SetAttribute("OldCowboyFeedHitbox", true)
	hitbox.Parent = self.npc

	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = hitbox
	weld.Parent = hitbox

	self.feedHitbox = hitbox
	self.feedTouchConnection = hitbox.Touched:Connect(function(touchedPart)
		self:_tryFeedCookedMeat(touchedPart)
	end)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_syncAmbushAttributes(active)
	self.ambushActive = active
	local targets = {
		self.npc,
		self.stage1Building,
		self.stage2Building,
	}
	for _, target in pairs(targets) do
		if target and target.Parent then
			target:SetAttribute("OldCowboyAmbushActive", active)
			target:SetAttribute("OldCowboyAmbushWave", self.ambushWave or 0)
		end
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_isAmbushLifecycleActive(generation)
	return generation == self.ambushGeneration
		and self.state == self.State.ESCORT
		and self.npc ~= nil
		and self.npc.Parent ~= nil
		and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(self.npc)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_waitAmbushSeconds(seconds, generation)
	local remaining = seconds
	while remaining > 0 do
		if not self:_isAmbushLifecycleActive(generation) then
			return false
		end
		local elapsed = task.wait(math.min(1, remaining))
		if self.owner and self.owner.Parent == Players and GameHelper:isAlive(self.owner) then
			remaining -= elapsed
		end
	end
	return self:_isAmbushLifecycleActive(generation)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_countNearbyAmbushPlayers()
	local npcRoot = getRoot(self.npc)
	if not npcRoot then
		return 0
	end
	local count = 0
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if GameHelper:isAlive(player) then
			local character = player.Character
			local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if playerRoot and (playerRoot.Position - npcRoot.Position).Magnitude <= AMBUSH_PLAYER_COUNT_RADIUS then
				count += 1
			end
		end
	end
	return count
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_getAliveAmbushCount()
	local count = 0
	for enemy, record in pairs(self.ambushEnemies) do
		if enemy.Parent and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(enemy) then
			count += 1
		elseif not enemy.Parent then
			if record.deathConnection and record.deathConnection.Connected then
				record.deathConnection:Disconnect()
			end
			self.ambushEnemies[enemy] = nil
		end
	end
	return count
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_destroyAmbushEnemy(enemy)
	local record = self.ambushEnemies[enemy]
	if record and record.deathConnection and record.deathConnection.Connected then
		record.deathConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	self.ambushEnemies[enemy] = nil
	if enemy and enemy.Parent then
		enemy:Destroy()
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_destroyAllAmbushEnemies()
	local enemies = {}
	for enemy in pairs(self.ambushEnemies) do
		table.insert(enemies, enemy)
	end
	for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
		self:_destroyAmbushEnemy(enemy)
	end
	if self.ambushFolder and self.ambushFolder.Parent then
		for _, child in ipairs(self.ambushFolder:GetChildren()) do
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	self:_syncAmbushAttributes(false)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_stopAmbushes(destroyEnemies, cleanupDelay)
	self.ambushGeneration = (self.ambushGeneration or 0) + 1
	self:_syncAmbushAttributes(false)
	if destroyEnemies then
		self:_destroyAllAmbushEnemies()
	elseif cleanupDelay and cleanupDelay > 0 then
		local folder = self.ambushFolder
		task.delay(cleanupDelay, function()
			if folder ~= self.ambushFolder then
				return
			end
			self:_destroyAllAmbushEnemies()
		end)
	end
	self:_refreshEscortBubble()
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_isInsideCemeteryTrigger(position)
	local trigger = self.cemeteryTrigger
	if not trigger or not trigger:IsA("BasePart") then
		return false
	end
	local localPosition = trigger.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local halfSize = trigger.Size * 0.5 + Vector3.new(8, 0, 8)
	return math.abs(localPosition.X) <= halfSize.X
		and math.abs(localPosition.Z) <= halfSize.Z
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_isAmbushSpawnAreaClear(spawnCFrame, ground)
	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	local filter = {self.npc, self.ambushFolder}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character then
			table.insert(filter, player.Character)
		end
	end
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local boxCFrame = spawnCFrame * CFrame.new(AMBUSH_MOUNTED_BOX_OFFSET)
	local hits = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(
		boxCFrame,
		AMBUSH_MOUNTED_CLEARANCE_SIZE,
		overlapParams
	)
	for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do
		if hit ~= ground and hit.CanCollide and not hit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ground) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_findAmbushSpawnCFrames(enemyCount)
	local npcRoot = getRoot(self.npc)
	local ownerRoot = self.owner and self.owner.Character and self.owner.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not npcRoot or not ownerRoot then
		return nil
	end

	local backDirection = -(ownerRoot.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1))
	if backDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 then
		backDirection = -(npcRoot.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1))
	end
	if backDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 then
		backDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	else
		backDirection = backDirection.Unit
	end

	local spawnCFrames = {}
	local mapParent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()
	for _ = 1, AMBUSH_MAX_SPAWN_ATTEMPTS do
		if #spawnCFrames >= enemyCount then
			break
		end
		local angle = math.rad(math.random(-65, 65))
		local cosAngle = math.cos(angle)
		local sinAngle = math.sin(angle)
		local direction = Vector3.new(
			backDirection.X * cosAngle - backDirection.Z * sinAngle,
			0,
			backDirection.X * sinAngle + backDirection.Z * cosAngle
		)
		local distance = math.random(AMBUSH_MIN_SPAWN_DISTANCE, AMBUSH_MAX_SPAWN_DISTANCE)
		local candidate = npcRoot.Position + direction * distance
		local gridX, gridZ = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(candidate)
		local ground = mapParent:FindFirstChild(string.format("%d,%d", gridX, gridZ))
		if not ground or not ground:IsA("BasePart") then
			continue
		end

		local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {ground}
		raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		local result = Workspace:Raycast(candidate + Vector3.yAxis * 100, Vector3.yAxis * -200, raycastParams)
		if not result or result.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
			continue
		end
		local position = result.Position + Vector3.yAxis * AMBUSH_MOUNTED_PIVOT_HEIGHT
		local lookPosition = Vector3.new(npcRoot.Position.X, position.Y, npcRoot.Position.Z)
		local spawnCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, lookPosition)
		if math.abs(position.Y - npcRoot.Position.Y) > AMBUSH_MAX_VERTICAL_OFFSET
			or GameHelper:IsInCampfire(position, 5)
			or self:_isInsideCemeteryTrigger(position)
			or not self:_isAmbushSpawnAreaClear(spawnCFrame, ground) then
			continue
		end

		local spaced = true
		for _, cframe in ipairs(spawnCFrames) do
			if (cframe.Position - position).Magnitude < AMBUSH_MIN_SPAWN_SPACING then
				spaced = false
				break
			end
		end
		if not spaced then
			continue
		end

		table.insert(spawnCFrames, spawnCFrame)
	end

	if #spawnCFrames < 2 then
		return nil
	end
	return spawnCFrames
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_showAmbushWarning(text)
	local recipients = {}
	if self.owner and self.owner.Parent == Players then
		recipients[self.owner] = true
	end
	local npcRoot = getRoot(self.npc)
	if npcRoot then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if GameHelper:isAlive(player) then
				local character = player.Character
				local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if playerRoot and (playerRoot.Position - npcRoot.Position).Magnitude <= AMBUSH_PLAYER_COUNT_RADIUS then
					recipients[player] = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for player in pairs(recipients) do
		UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, text, UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
	end
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_playAmbushWarningSound(spawnCFrames)
	local averagePosition = Vector3.zero
	for _, cframe in ipairs(spawnCFrames) do
		averagePosition += cframe.Position
	end
	averagePosition /= #spawnCFrames

	local soundAnchor = Instance.new("Part")
	soundAnchor.Name = "OldCowboyAmbushWarningSound"
	soundAnchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	soundAnchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(averagePosition)
	soundAnchor.Transparency = 1
	soundAnchor.Anchored = true
	soundAnchor.CanCollide = false
	soundAnchor.CanQuery = false
	soundAnchor.CanTouch = false
	soundAnchor.Parent = Workspace
	AudioHelper:PlayEffect("GunSound", soundAnchor)
	Debris:AddItem(soundAnchor, 5)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_spawnAmbushWave(generation)
	if not self:_isAmbushLifecycleActive(generation)
		or not self.owner
		or not GameHelper:isAlive(self.owner)
		or self.escortInCombat
		or self:_getAliveAmbushCount() > 0 then
		return false
	end

	local nearbyPlayers = self:_countNearbyAmbushPlayers()
	local enemyCount = math.clamp(nearbyPlayers + 1, 2, 4)
	local spawnCFrames = self:_findAmbushSpawnCFrames(enemyCount)
	if not spawnCFrames then
		return false
	end

	local nextWave = self.ambushWave + 1
	local warningLine = AMBUSH_FIRST_WARNING_LINE
	if nextWave > 1 then
		warningLine = AMBUSH_LATER_WARNING_LINES[math.random(1, #AMBUSH_LATER_WARNING_LINES)]
	end
	self:_showAmbushWarning(warningLine)
	self:_playAmbushWarningSound(spawnCFrames)
	task.wait(AMBUSH_WARNING_DURATION)

	if not self:_isAmbushLifecycleActive(generation)
		or not self.owner
		or not GameHelper:isAlive(self.owner) then
		return false
	end

	local tier = AMBUSH_ENEMY_TIERS[math.min(nextWave, #AMBUSH_ENEMY_TIERS)]
	local meleeId = tier.melee
	local gunId = tier.gun
	local spawnedEnemies = {}
	for index, cframe in ipairs(spawnCFrames) do
		local enemyId = index % 2 == 1 and meleeId or gunId
		local enemy = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId, self.ambushFolder)
		if enemy then
			enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher)
			enemy:SetAttribute("OldCowboyAmbushWave", nextWave)
			EnemyHelper:SetCustomOriginPos(enemy, cframe.Position)
			enemy:PivotTo(cframe)
			table.insert(spawnedEnemies, enemy)
		end
	end

	if #spawnedEnemies < 2 then
		for _, enemy in ipairs(spawnedEnemies) do
			enemy:Destroy()
		end
		return false
	end

	self.ambushWave = nextWave
	for _, enemy in ipairs(spawnedEnemies) do
		local record = {
			farSince = nil,
			deathConnection = nil,
			dead = false,
		}
		self.ambushEnemies[enemy] = record
		local humanoid = getHumanoid(enemy)
		if humanoid then
			record.deathConnection = humanoid.Died:Once(function()
				record.dead = true
				task.delay(AMBUSH_CORPSE_DURATION, function()
					if self.ambushEnemies[enemy] == record then
						self:_destroyAmbushEnemy(enemy)
					end
				end)
				self:_syncAmbushAttributes(self:_getAliveAmbushCount() > 0)
			end)
		else
			self:_destroyAmbushEnemy(enemy)
		end
	end
	self:_syncAmbushAttributes(self:_getAliveAmbushCount() > 0)
	return self:_getAliveAmbushCount() > 0
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_monitorAmbushWave(generation)
	local startedAt = Workspace.DistributedGameTime
	while self:_isAmbushLifecycleActive(generation) and self:_getAliveAmbushCount() > 0 do
		local now = Workspace.DistributedGameTime
		local npcRoot = getRoot(self.npc)
		local enemiesToRetire = {}
		for enemy, record in pairs(self.ambushEnemies) do
			if enemy.Parent and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(enemy) then
				local enemyRoot = getRoot(enemy)
				local distance = npcRoot and enemyRoot and (enemyRoot.Position - npcRoot.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
				if distance > AMBUSH_RETIRE_DISTANCE then
					record.farSince = record.farSince or now
					if now - record.farSince >= AMBUSH_RETIRE_GRACE then
						table.insert(enemiesToRetire, enemy)
					end
				else
					record.farSince = nil
				end
			end
		end
		for _, enemy in ipairs(enemiesToRetire) do
			self:_destroyAmbushEnemy(enemy)
		end
		if now - startedAt >= AMBUSH_MAX_WAVE_LIFETIME then
			local timedOutEnemies = {}
			for enemy in pairs(self.ambushEnemies) do
				if enemy.Parent and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(enemy) then
					table.insert(timedOutEnemies, enemy)
				end
			end
			for _, enemy in ipairs(timedOutEnemies) do
				self:_destroyAmbushEnemy(enemy)
			end
			break
		end
		task.wait(2)
	end
	self:_syncAmbushAttributes(false)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_startAmbushes()
	self:_stopAmbushes(true)
	self.ambushWave = 0
	self.ambushGeneration += 1
	local generation = self.ambushGeneration
	self:_syncAmbushAttributes(false)

	task.spawn(function()
		while self:_isAmbushLifecycleActive(generation) do
			if not self:_waitAmbushSeconds(math.random(AMBUSH_MIN_DELAY, AMBUSH_MAX_DELAY), generation) then
				return
			end

			local spawned = false
			repeat
				while self:_isAmbushLifecycleActive(generation)
					and (not self.owner or not GameHelper:isAlive(self.owner) or self.escortInCombat or self:_getAliveAmbushCount() > 0) do
					task.wait(1)
				end
				if not self:_isAmbushLifecycleActive(generation) then
					return
				end
				spawned = self:_spawnAmbushWave(generation)
				if not spawned and not self:_waitAmbushSeconds(AMBUSH_RETRY_DELAY, generation) then
					return
				end
			until spawned

			self:_monitorAmbushWave(generation)
		end
	end)
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_startEscort(player)
	self:_setOwner(player)
	self:_setState(self.State.ESCORT)

	setTalkBubble(self.npc, "", false)
	self:_ensureForceField()

	self.npc.Parent = Workspace
	self.npc.Name = "Old Cowboy"
	local humanoid = getHumanoid(self.npc)
	local root = getRoot(self.npc)
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.MaxHealth = 250
		humanoid.Health = 250
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
		humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
	end
	if root then
		root.Anchored = false
	end

	ValueHelper:InitByModel(self.npc, AnimalBuddyValue)
	ValueHelper:InitByModel(self.npc, BuddyAttributeValue)
	ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(self.npc, BuddyAttributeValue.walkSpeed, "OldCowboyQuest", 16)
	ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(self.npc, BuddyAttributeValue.attackDistance, "OldCowboyQuest", 50)
	ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(self.npc, BuddyAttributeValue.attackCD, "OldCowboyQuest", 1)
	ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(self.npc, BuddyAttributeValue.atkDamage, "OldCowboyQuest", 40)
	ValueHelper:SetValue(self.npc, BuddyAttributeValue.displayName, "Old Cowboy")
	ValueHelper:SetValue(self.npc, AnimalBuddyValue.ownerPlayer, player)
	ValueHelper:SetValue(self.npc, AnimalBuddyValue.targetEnemy, nil)

	self:_equipEscortPistol()
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.Buddy, true)
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion, true)
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.EscortTarget, true)
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.AnimalBuddy, true)
	self:_startEscortStatus()
	self:_startFeedTouch()
	self:_startAmbushes()
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_handleAcceptEscort(player)
	if self.state ~= self.State.RESCUED or self.claimInProgress or self.owner then
		return
	end
	if not self:_isPlayerNearNpc(player, 16) then
		return
	end

	self.claimInProgress = true
	local stage2 = self:_prepareStage2()
	if not stage2 then
		self.claimInProgress = false
		UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, "The cemetery could not be found. Please try again.", UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
		return
	end
	self:_startEscort(player)
	UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, "Escort contract accepted — keep the Old Cowboy alive for five gems.")
	self.claimInProgress = false
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_stopEscortForCemetery()
	self:_stopAmbushes(true)
	self:_stopFeedTouch()
	self:_stopEscortStatus()
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.AnimalBuddy, false)
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.EscortTarget, false)
	setTag(self.npc, GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion, false)
	local ownerValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(self.npc, AnimalBuddyValue.ownerPlayer)
	local targetValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(self.npc, AnimalBuddyValue.targetEnemy)
	if ownerValue then
		ownerValue.Value = nil
	end
	if targetValue then
		targetValue.Value = nil
	end
	local root = getRoot(self.npc)
	local humanoid = getHumanoid(self.npc)
	if root then
		root.Anchored = true
	end
	if self.cemeteryNpcCFrame then
		self.npc:PivotTo(self.cemeteryNpcCFrame)
	end
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.MaxHealth = 1000000000
		humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
	end
	self:_ensureForceField()
	self.npc.Name = "Old Cowboy"
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_beginCemeteryFilm()
	if self.state ~= self.State.ESCORT or not self.owner then
		return
	end
	self:_setState(self.State.CEMETERY_FILM)
	if self.cemeteryTrigger and self.cemeteryTrigger:IsA("BasePart") then
		self.cemeteryTrigger.CanTouch = false
	end
	self:_stopEscortForCemetery()
	setTalkBubble(self.npc, "", false)

	local ownerAtStart = self.owner
	local cam1 = self.stage2Root and self.stage2Root:FindFirstChild("cam1")
	local cam2 = self.stage2Root and self.stage2Root:FindFirstChild("cam2")
	local cam1CFrame = cam1 and cam1:IsA("Attachment") and cam1.WorldCFrame or nil
	local cam2CFrame = cam2 and cam2:IsA("Attachment") and cam2.WorldCFrame or nil
	cemeteryFilmEvent:FireClient(ownerAtStart, cam1CFrame, cam2CFrame)
	task.delay(15, function()
		if self.state == self.State.CEMETERY_FILM then
			self:_finishCemeteryFilm()
		end
	end)
end
